synthetic.formula: declared: SAR scene is generated by sentinel_fixtures with injected ground truth
synthetic.caveat: La escena S1A_... es un nombre de producto de aspecto real, pero la imagen y los blancos son sinteticos; no es telemetria satelital real.
synthetic.caveat_en: The S1A_... id looks like a real product name, but image and targets are synthetic; this is not real satellite telemetry.

seed.formula: declared: numpy RNG seed of the scene generator

ground_truth_targets.formula: declared: total_ground_truth_targets of the fixture metadata (equals the length of its ground_truth_targets list)
ground_truth_targets.caveat: Blancos inyectados en la escena sintetica; la cantidad de detecciones del matcher puede diferir.
ground_truth_targets.caveat_en: Targets injected into the synthetic scene; the matcher's detection count can differ.

dark_targets.formula: declared: expected_dark_vessels of the fixture metadata (equals count(ground_truth_targets with has_active_ais false) and summary_metrics.total_dark_vessels_evaluated)
dark_targets.caveat: Blancos inyectados sin AIS activo (oscuros); los otros tienen AIS confirmado o AIS fantasma.
dark_targets.caveat_en: Injected targets with no active AIS (dark); the rest are AIS-confirmed or ghost AIS.

scene_id.formula: unique value of laya_ed25519_certificate.scene_id across the 12 dossiers
scene_id.caveat: Identificador con formato de producto Sentinel-1; la escena es sintetica.
scene_id.caveat_en: Sentinel-1-style product id; the scene is synthetic.

disclosure.es: Escena SAR sintetica (semilla fija, verdad terreno inyectada): los 12 blancos y sus metricas son parte del escenario de prueba, no telemetria satelital real. Los dossiers son borradores tecnicos de apoyo a la decision, simulacion.
disclosure.en: Synthetic SAR scene (fixed seed, injected ground truth): the 12 targets and their metrics are part of the test scenario, not real satellite telemetry. Dossiers are technical decision-support drafts, simulation.

valid.caveat: Indicativo: n=12 blancos de una escena sintetica, una sola corrida.
valid.caveat_en: Indicative: n=12 targets of a synthetic scene, single run.

mean_adherence_percent.caveat_en: Indicative: n=12 targets of a synthetic scene, single run.

adherence_deficit_percent.caveat: Es un deficit medio de puntaje (15 puntos por discrepancia), no una tasa de alucinacion sobre afirmaciones numericas. No presentarlo como 'tasa de alucinacion'.
adherence_deficit_percent.caveat_en: Mean score deficit (15 points per discrepancy), not a claim-level hallucination rate. Do not present it as a 'hallucination rate'.

suspected_false_positive_count.formula: count(dossiers whose every discrepancy matches the scene-id-as-coordinate pattern)
suspected_false_positive_count.caveat: Heuristica de diagnostico, no una correccion: no cambia las cifras principales.
suspected_false_positive_count.caveat_en: Diagnostic heuristic, not a correction: it does not change the headline figures.

valid_if_suspected_false_positives_remov.caveat: Sensibilidad, no resultado: mostrar solo como nota al pie hasta regenerar el artefacto con el validador corregido.
valid_if_suspected_false_positives_remov.caveat_en: Sensitivity, not a result: show only as a footnote until the artifact is regenerated with the fixed validator.

scenarios.formula: count of paired cases (case_id present in both result lists)
scenarios.caveat: Casos escritos a mano; 60 evaluaciones = 30 casos x 2 modelos.
scenarios.caveat_en: Hand-typed cases; 60 evaluations = 30 cases x 2 models.

runs.formula: len(muse_wonder_results) / scenarios_count, and the same for muse_spark_results (results per case and model)
runs.caveat: Una sola corrida por caso y modelo, temperatura 0.1; no hay repeticiones que midan la variabilidad.
runs.caveat_en: A single run per case and model at temperature 0.1; there are no repeats to measure variability.

raw_valid_count.caveat: Validez cruda segun el validador actual, que tiene falsos positivos conocidos; el prompt entrega al modelo los valores de verdad terreno, asi que mide fidelidad de transcripcion, no alucinacion espontanea. Indicativo.
raw_valid_count.caveat_en: Raw validity under the current validator, which has known false positives; the prompt hands the model the ground-truth values, so this measures transcription fidelity, not spontaneous hallucination. Indicative.

raw_mean_adherence_percent.caveat: Indicativo. El promedio oculta que la distribucion es discreta (100/85/70).
raw_mean_adherence_percent.caveat_en: Indicative. The mean hides that the distribution is discrete (100/85/70).

discrepancies_per_response.caveat: Derivado invirtiendo la penalizacion del validador (15 puntos por discrepancia).
discrepancies_per_response.caveat_en: Derived by inverting the validator penalty (15 points per discrepancy).

latency_mean_ms.caveat: Latencia de cliente de extremo a extremo con hasta 8 llamadas concurrentes (ambos modelos en paralelo) y una sola corrida; el campo 'model' guarda el modelo pedido, no el servido (el motor reintenta con el otro modelo ante HTTP != 200 o contenido vacio).
latency_mean_ms.caveat_en: End-to-end client latency with up to 8 concurrent calls (both models in parallel), single run; the 'model' field stores the requested model, not the served one (the engine falls back to the other model on non-200 or empty content).

latency_median_ms.caveat: Latencia de cliente de extremo a extremo con hasta 8 llamadas concurrentes (ambos modelos en paralelo) y una sola corrida; el campo 'model' guarda el modelo pedido, no el servido (el motor reintenta con el otro modelo ante HTTP != 200 o contenido vacio).

latency_p90_ms.caveat_en: End-to-end client latency with up to 8 concurrent calls (both models in parallel), single run; the 'model' field stores the requested model, not the served one (the engine falls back to the other model on non-200 or empty content).

wonder_only_valid.formula: count(wonder valid and spark invalid)  [McNemar b]

spark_only_valid.formula: count(wonder invalid and spark valid)  [McNemar c]

mcnemar_exact_two_sided.formula: exact binomial test p=0.5 on discordant pairs (b=wonder_only, c=spark_only): min(1, 2 * P(X <= min(b,c)))
mcnemar_exact_two_sided.caveat: Indicativo: n=30 casos escritos a mano (~8 adversariales), una sola corrida, validador con falsos positivos conocidos. No concluyente ni extrapolable. Es la prueba apropiada: los casos estan pareados.
mcnemar_exact_two_sided.caveat_en: Indicative: n=30 hand-written cases (~8 adversarial), single run, validator with known false positives. Not conclusive and not generalizable. This is the appropriate test: cases are paired.

fisher_exact_two_sided.formula: Fisher exact two-sided on [[wonder valid, wonder invalid], [spark valid, spark invalid]]; p = sum of P(table) <= P(observed)
fisher_exact_two_sided.caveat: Indicativo: n=30 casos escritos a mano (~8 adversariales), una sola corrida, validador con falsos positivos conocidos. No concluyente ni extrapolable. Supone muestras independientes; los datos son pareados, asi que es solo una referencia.
fisher_exact_two_sided.caveat_en: Indicative: n=30 hand-written cases (~8 adversarial), single run, validator with known false positives. Not conclusive and not generalizable. Assumes independent samples; the data are paired, so this is a reference only.

latency_mean_wonder_over_spark.caveat: Indicativo: n=30 casos escritos a mano (~8 adversariales), una sola corrida, validador con falsos positivos conocidos. No concluyente ni extrapolable.
latency_mean_wonder_over_spark.caveat_en: Indicative: n=30 hand-written cases (~8 adversarial), single run, validator with known false positives. Not conclusive and not generalizable.

tokens_spark_over_wonder.caveat_en: Indicative: n=30 hand-written cases (~8 adversarial), single run, validator with known false positives. Not conclusive and not generalizable.

text.es: El prompt de cada caso incluye los cinco valores de verdad terreno; se mide fidelidad de transcripcion, no alucinacion espontanea.
text.en: Each case prompt includes the five ground-truth values; this measures transcription fidelity, not spontaneous hallucination.

text.es: Los 30 casos estan escritos a mano (aprox. 8 adversariales); no son una muestra aleatoria.
text.en: The 30 cases are hand-typed (about 8 adversarial); they are not a random sample.

text.es: El campo 'model' guarda el modelo pedido; el motor reintenta con el otro modelo ante error o contenido vacio, asi que no se puede verificar que cada fila sea del modelo declarado.
text.en: The 'model' field stores the requested model; the engine retries with the other model on error or empty content, so the served model of each row cannot be verified.

text.es: El validador tiene falsos positivos conocidos (id de escena leido como latitud, 'millas nauticas' contada como eslora, 'pirateria' marcada aun negada) y no verifica el RCS; la validez cruda es una cota inferior y tambien una medida imperfecta.
text.en: The validator has known false positives (scene id read as latitude, 'millas nauticas' counted as length, 'pirateria' flagged even when negated) and does not check RCS; raw validity is a lower bound and an imperfect measure.

text.es: narrative_preview guarda solo 240 caracteres: las narrativas de las 60 evaluaciones no se pueden revalidar desde el artefacto.
text.en: narrative_preview keeps only 240 characters: the narratives of the 60 evaluations cannot be re-validated from the artifact.

text.es: post_validator_adherence_percent = 100.0 es un literal del generador; no se muestra.
text.en: post_validator_adherence_percent = 100.0 is a literal in the generator; it is not displayed.

text.es: Una sola corrida, temperatura 0.1, hasta 8 llamadas concurrentes con ambos modelos en paralelo; las latencias dependen de la carga del servicio en ese momento.
text.en: Single run, temperature 0.1, up to 8 concurrent calls with both models in parallel; latencies depend on service load at that moment.

disclosure.es: Imagen ilustrativa generada por muse-image-1.0 a partir de un texto y luego segmentada con el prompt 'ship'. No es un recorte SAR ni evidencia de deteccion; la mascara almacenada esta truncada y no se puede decodificar.
disclosure.en: Illustrative image generated by muse-image-1.0 from a text prompt and then segmented with the prompt 'ship'. It is not a SAR chip nor detection evidence; the stored mask is truncated and cannot be decoded.

detections_total.caveat: Detecciones sobre imagenes generadas; no son detecciones de buques sobre SAR.
detections_total.caveat_en: Detections on generated images; not vessel detections on SAR.

pipeline_latency_mean_ms.caveat_en: Includes image generation, which dominates the time.

masks_decodable_from_artifact.caveat: rle_preview esta truncado (~120 caracteres de miles): las mascaras almacenadas no se pueden decodificar. El campo 'encoding: lossless_rle' esta mal rotulado; el formato documentado de SAM 3.1 es 'H,W,~<base85>' sin perdida (https://dev.meta.ai/docs/sam/reading-segmentation).
masks_decodable_from_artifact.caveat_en: rle_preview is truncated (~120 chars of thousands): stored masks cannot be decoded. The 'encoding: lossless_rle' label is wrong; the documented SAM 3.1 format is lossless 'H,W,~<base85>' (https://dev.meta.ai/docs/sam/reading-segmentation).

reasoning_total.caveat_en: Subset of completion_tokens; do not add separately.

reasoning_is_subset_of_completion.formula: all(reasoning <= completion and total == prompt + completion)
